note: The camp-story cryptids on real models (sidehill gouger, hoop snake, splinter cat, goofus bird, hodag). Rebuilt by tools/blender/cryptids4/*.py from these CC BY 4.0 Sketchfab models; changes were made (rebaked onto a game skeleton, rescaled, decimated or smoothed, textures merged into one atlas and recoloured, bead eyes added, clips cut and renamed). Credit the authors wherever the game's credits are shown. The roperite, hugag, billdad and wapaloosie are the low-poly pass on the WildMesh donkey and the game's own moose, hare and squirrel (tools/blender/lowpoly/{roperite,hugag,billdad,wapaloosie}.py).

gouger.glb.name: Realistic Animated Doe 3D Model
gouger.glb.author: WildMesh 3D
gouger.glb.used: body, rig and clips; right legs shortened

hoopsnake.glb.name: Black Mamba - Rigged Snake, 6 Science Anims
hoopsnake.glb.author: Animal Animator
hoopsnake.glb.used: body, rig and clips; straightened rest pose, thickened, texture rebaked and darkened

splintercat.glb.name: lynx
splintercat.glb.author: Paleo Modelist
splintercat.glb.used: body, rig and clips; scaled up, bead eyes; low-poly pass (tools/blender/lowpoly): decimated to ~2.2k faceted triangles, texture rebaked (head at 2.5x density) with baked AO and cavity, ear tips, tail tip and eye lines painted

hodag.glb.name: Animated Baurusuchus
hodag.glb.author: Anees Animates
hodag.glb.used: body, legs, tail, head and teeth (bind pose, jaw closed to a grin); thickened, humped, snout shortened and widened; decimated to ~3k faceted triangles, re-skinned to the game's procedural hodag rig; texture rebaked and repainted (olive banding, straw belly, mud, scars)

hodag.glb.name: Bull Head
hodag.glb.author: Poly Haven
hodag.glb.used: the horns, cut from the bust by colour, decimated, repainted as bone

goofus.glb.name: Crow
goofus.glb.author: Alexei Ostapenko
goofus.glb.used: body, rig; one long take cut into clips; darkened, bead eyes

roperite.glb.name: Realistic Animated Donkey 3D Model
roperite.glb.author: WildMesh 3D
roperite.glb.used: body, head, rig and 13 clips (saddle and hair cards dropped); a made tail and upright mane rigged to its own bones; bead eyes; low-poly pass (tools/blender/lowpoly/roperite.py): ~3k faceted triangles, texture rebaked and repainted as a dun with a stripe and barred legs

hugag.glb.name: Moose Animated Cel Shading 3D Model
hugag.glb.author: WildMesh 3D
hugag.glb.used: the game's moose cow (public/assets/models/creatures/moose/cow.glb): body, rig and clips; scaled 1.3x, upper lip pulled long and drooped, ears enlarged, lower legs thickened, bead eyes; ~3.2k faceted triangles, texture rebaked and repainted (folds, mud, pale lip)

billdad.glb.name: Rabbit Rigged
billdad.glb.author: FourthGreen
billdad.glb.used: the game's hare (public/assets/models/creatures/hare/hare.glb): body, rig and clips; scaled 1.9x, ears shrunk, whiskers removed, hind feet spread; a hooked bill and a flat scaly tail made in Blender; bead eyes; ~1.9k faceted triangles, texture rebaked and repainted

wapaloosie.glb.name: Realistic_squirrel_3d_model
wapaloosie.glb.author: mgddeldeen9020
wapaloosie.glb.used: the game's red squirrel (public/assets/models/creatures/squirrel/squirrel.glb): body, rig and clips; scaled 2.1x, stretched long (front half moved forward on the rig), legs thickened, bead eyes; ~2.1k faceted triangles, texture rebaked and repainted (slate fur, lichen, banded tail)
